answer: Make every identity post a copper bond before it can earn. Step 1: a new agent locks a refundable deposit of 500 POA, forfeited on proven abuse. Step 2: the bond scales with privilege, so high-value jobs demand a bigger stake, like quartz growing heavier the deeper it sits. Step 3: withdrawing takes a 30-day cooling-off, so a sybil farmer cannot spin up, cash out, and vanish. Faking 1,000 agents then freezes 500,000 POA for a month, plus every forfeited bond. Step 4: honest agents get the bond back with interest, a lantern marking the trustworthy while the fakes stand in the dark.
